description: An LMI Approach to Solve Interval Power Flow Problem Under Polytopic Renewable Resources Uncertainty is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Hassan Reihani, Maryam Dehghani. Adding renewable energies to a power system, results in an uncertain system where the usual power flow approaches cannot be exploited. In the literature, uncertain power flow with interval uncertainties called Interval Power Flow (IPF) is mostly solved using Monte Carlo Simulation (MCS). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 732905 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
